name: AetherBuilder
changelog: New: Sticky Bottom Publish Dock in Sidebar - '🚀 Publish Live' button permanently accessible at the bottom of the sidebar drawer on mobile portrait web browsers and desktop
New: Mobile Live Preview QR Code - 1-click '📱' button in Topbar and Sidebar Dock generates a crisp scannable QR Code to immediately test live sites on phones
New: 1-Click '📋 Copy Live URL' - quickly copy public site link from the Topbar, Sidebar Dock, or QR Modal with instant toast feedback

Performance: Client-Side Photo Auto-Optimizer - oversized raster images (>1.2MB / >1920px) are automatically scaled and compressed on canvas before upload, speeding up uploads 10x and saving server disk space
UX: Floating 'Back to Top' Button in Site Settings (⚙️ Site Tab) - smooth circular button that appears when scrolling down, bringing visitors back to the top with one tap
Mobile UX: Responsive Topbar improvements - brand title collapses to icon on phone screens and actions container supports horizontal scrolling, preventing button clipping in portrait mode
Performance: Instant Page Loading (Splash Screen & Pre-loader 100% Optional) - when disabled, the entire black screen, spinner overlay, and initialization delay are completely bypassed
UX: Fully disableable Sub-caption - unchecking 'Show' on Sub-caption immediately eliminates 'Initializing modules & layout engine' text and its timing
